【航向世界 | 紀錄片放映暨生職涯講座】 (English version below) 你是否曾夢想駕帆遠航，靠著太陽、月亮與星星指引方向，征服廣闊的海洋？ 陳懷璞，一位以雙手與意志馴服大海的探險家。他不僅是英國皇家遊艇協會（RYA）認證的職業級航海大師船長，更成為全球最年輕、無動力帆船成功橫跨北大西洋的航海者。他用天文導航技術，與海浪搏鬥 47 天，抵達新大陸，為台灣航海史寫下傳奇。他的名字，甚至被美國麻省理工學院（MIT）林肯實驗室命名為小行星「15554 Chenhuaipu」，象徵其對航海探險的非凡貢獻。 從基隆海邊的童年，到全球海洋論壇的台灣代表；從魚能發電的科展冠軍，到YouTube紀錄片《海上尋家的探險家》超過 10 萬觀看次數。陳懷璞以行動證明：「世界比我們想的還大，而勇氣是通往夢想的秘訣。」 如果你對海洋、冒險、科學懷抱夢想，卻不確定未來的方向，這場講座將讓你看到更多可能——或許，你也能找到屬於自己的航道。 📆 時間：5/2（五）14：00～17：00 📍 地點：環境暨海洋學院階梯教室 📝 報名方式：上跨域自主系統查詢【生職涯講座】 - 航向世界 | 紀錄片放映 （https://sys.ndhu.edu.tw/SA/XSL_ApplyRWD/ActApply.aspx） 🎤 講者經歷 ✅ 2025 年 無動力帆船成功橫跨北大西洋，世界最年輕達成此壯舉者 ✅ 2025 年 小行星 15554 以「Chenhuaipu」命名，表彰其航海探險成就 ✅ 2024 年 英國皇家遊艇協會職業級航海大師船長（RYA Yachtmaster Offshore） ✅ 2024 年 受邀登上綠色和平旗艦「彩虹勇士號」進行環境行動航行 ✅ 2023 年 Gap Year 期間航行太平洋、大西洋，進行海洋環境數據收集 ✅ 2022 年 代表台灣參與聯合國級「OUR OCEAN」海洋大會，成為全球海洋大使 ✅ 2019 年 Intel 國際科展工程學二等獎（魚能發電），台灣國際科展一等獎 📢 名額有限，趕快報名，一起來聆聽這位逐夢海洋的探險家如何駛向世界的更遠方！ 🌊⛵ —--------------------------------------------------------------------- 【 Sailing Beyond Borders | Documentary Screening & Career Talk】 Ever dreamed of setting sail, guided only by the sun, moon, and stars? Conquering vast oceans with nothing but skill and determination? Meet Chen Huaipu, an adventurer who tamed the sea with his hands and willpower. A RYA-certified Yachtmaster Offshore Captain, he became the youngest person ever to cross the North Atlantic on a non-motorized sailboat. Using only celestial navigation, he battled the waves for 47 days to reach the New World, leaving his mark on Taiwan’s maritime history. His name now shines among the stars—MIT’s Lincoln Laboratory named Asteroid 15554 "Chenhuaipu" in honor of his achievements. From a childhood on Keelung’s shores to representing Taiwan at global ocean summits, from inventing electricity-generating fish to captivating 100K+ viewers on YouTube with his documentary The Explorer Seeking Home at Sea, Chen proves one thing: ✨ The world is bigger than we think, and courage is the key to chasing dreams. ✨ If you dream of the ocean, adventure, or science but feel uncertain about the future, this talk will open new horizons. Perhaps, you'll find your own course to sail. 📆 Date & Time: May 2 (Fri) | 14:00 – 17:00 📍 Venue: Lecture Hall, College of Environmental Studies & Oceanography 📝 Sign-up: Access Cross-Disciplinary Autonomous System Inquiry【生職涯講座】 - 航向世界 | 紀錄片放映 🎤 Speaker Highlights ✅ 2025 – Youngest person to cross the North Atlantic on a non-motorized sailboat ✅ 2025 – Asteroid 15554 officially named "Chenhuaipu" for his maritime achievements ✅ 2024 – RYA-certified Yachtmaster Offshore (UK Royal Yachting Association) ✅ 2024 – Joined Greenpeace’s Rainbow Warrior on an environmental mission ✅ 2023 – Sailed across the Pacific & Atlantic, collecting ocean data during his gap year ✅ 2022 – Represented Taiwan at the OUR OCEAN Conference, advocating for marine conservation ✅ 2019 – Intel ISEF Engineering Award Winner (Electricity-Generating Fish Project) 📢 Limited spots available! Sign up now and set sail on an unforgettable journey with this fearless explorer! 🌊⛵
